data.meta_observations: Critical thinking appears as the most pervasive theme across diverse disciplines (medicine, law, languages, engineering). Three distinct patterns emerged: 1) procedural critique of AI outputs, 2) metacognitive scaffolding through AI interactivity, and 3) ethical- pedagogical tensions. Surprisingly few abstracts explicitly mentioned 'creative thinking' despite common focus on generative AI. Multiple studies showed AI's capacity to enhance lower-order cognitive skills more readily than higher-order capabilities
data.grounding_notes: Critical thinking theme covers 22/27 articles in this batch. Verification needed for low-frequency themes like adaptive learning systems. No abstracts explicitly mentioned 'digital literacy' or 'information literacy' despite related implications. Several studies noted inconsistent impacts across Bloom's taxonomy levels.
